Classic Style Meets Modern Security

French doors add a touch of timeless elegance to any home, but their multi-pane design can create multiple points of vulnerability. Each small pane of glass, known as a "divided light," is a potential entry point for an intruder. Security window film provides a comprehensive solution, reinforcing every pane to create a unified and secure barrier.

The Challenge of Securing French Doors

The traditional beauty of French doors lies in their details, but this can also be a security weakness. An intruder doesn't need to break the entire door; they only need to break a single small pane near the handle to reach in and unlock the door from the inside. Applying security film to these panes completely negates this tactic.

  • Pane-by-Pane Protection: Our expert installers cut a custom piece of security film for each individual glass pane, ensuring a perfect fit and complete coverage.
  • Prevents Easy Access: Even if a pane is broken, the film holds the glass together, preventing an intruder from reaching the lock.
  • Invisible Upgrade: Optically clear security film is virtually undetectable, preserving the classic aesthetic of your French doors without any visual alteration.

More Than Just Security

Beyond providing a powerful deterrent to break-ins, filming your French doors also offers:

  • Accident Protection: Holds glass together in case of accidental impact, protecting your family from dangerous shards.
  • UV Rejection: Blocks 99% of UV rays to prevent the fading of nearby flooring, furniture, and artwork.
  • Optional Solar Control: Choose a combination film to also reduce heat and glare, making the room more comfortable and energy-efficient.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is it time-consuming to film every single pane?

Yes, filming French doors is a detailed and meticulous process that requires a skilled technician. However, our team is highly experienced and works efficiently to complete the installation with precision and care. The superior protection is well worth the detailed effort.

My French doors have a decorative grid. Can they still be filmed?

It depends on the type of grid. If it's a 'true divided light' door with individual panes, we film each one. If it's a decorative grid attached to the surface of a single large pane of glass, we may need to remove it to apply the film and then re-attach it. We can assess the door during our consultation.

Will the film affect the door's seal or weatherstripping?

No. The film is applied to the interior surface of the glass panes and is trimmed precisely within the frame, so it does not interfere with any of the door's seals, weatherstripping, or operational hardware.
